title: 虛擬語氣(I suggest he be…)

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: HR recommended that I submit the form by Friday.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: And it's essential that everyone be on time.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: The director insisted that the meeting not be moved.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: I'd suggest that she speak to them first.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: It's vital that she be told.
